verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents CDP interoperability: `localBrowser.connect` attaches to any Chromium browser you already run, by URL. It also says you can use familiar page methods when you want zero inference. This lets existing CDP-driven setups share a browser with Stagehand, but it runs in the reverse direction: Stagehand connects to your browser, not your Playwright/Puppeteer code to its browsers. Missing for 10: documented exposure of a CDP/WebSocket endpoint for Stagehand/Browserbase browsers, explicit support for running existing Playwright or Puppeteer scripts unchanged, and hands-on corroboration.
